content: Melvin-Koushki says earlier characterisations err in taking over Henry Corbin's assumption that Ibn Turka is a standard-issue Shiʿi esotericist, and in focusing on the Tamhīd al-Qawāʿid, which he calls strictly of secondary importance in the estimation of the author and his contemporaries.
refers_to_primary: Corbin on Ibn Turka (per MK p.8)
